title: SOURCE_TARGETS retired: importer job metadata SQL uses DXF/task-manager sessions

analysis: The dynamic hits in importer/job.go are helper functions over mysql.tidb_import_jobs; the SQL executor is supplied by callers, so the target depends entirely on conn ownership
IMPORT INTO submit path calls storage.GetTaskManager and taskManager.WithNewTxn, then passes the new task-manager session's SQL executor into importer.CreateJob

SHOW IMPORT JOBS and SHOW IMPORT GROUPS explicitly avoid the user session because users may not have system-table privileges; both use taskManager.WithNewSession before calling importer.GetJob/GetAllViewableJobs/GetJobsByGroupKey
IMPORT INTO action/cancel checks also use taskManager.WithNewSession, and cancel updates route through DXF service task-manager sessions
Scheduler status updates StartJob/Job2Step/UpdateJobPreparedInfo/FinishJob/FailJob/CancelJob all call importer/job helpers from taskManager.WithNewSession or WithNewTxn

TaskManager.WithNewSession borrows a session from its own session pool; WithNewTxn wraps that new session in an internal transaction. This is not the user statement session that might hold pending TxnReadTS/SnapshotInfoschema
source_anchors: pkg/dxf/importinto/job.go:84-117 obtains storage.GetTaskManager, enters taskManager.WithNewTxn, and calls importer.CreateJob with se.GetSQLExecutor()
pkg/executor/show.go:2805-2844 uses taskManager.WithNewSession for SHOW IMPORT JOBS before calling importer.GetJob/GetAllViewableJobs
pkg/executor/show.go:2708-2727 uses taskManager.WithNewSession for SHOW IMPORT GROUPS before calling importer.GetJobsByGroupKey
pkg/dxf/importinto/scheduler.go:770-880 scheduler updates importer job state through taskManager.WithNewSession/WithNewTxn
pkg/dxf/importinto/scheduler.go:906-914 getTaskMgrForAccessingImportJob returns a task manager backed by TaskRuntime.SysSessionPool for user keyspace
pkg/dxf/framework/storage/task_table.go:192-225 WithNewSession borrows from mgr.sePool, and WithNewTxn begins/commits/rolls back on that borrowed session
payload.why_not_execute: A pending-TxnReadTS RED would require the task-manager session pool to inherit the user session's one-shot stale-read state. The source chain proves product code intentionally uses separate system/task sessions for privilege and background metadata reasons.
payload.method_lesson: For auxiliary statement wrappers, helper package location is not enough. Record the conn/session provider as the ownership proof; task-manager sessions should be negative cache for current-session state-ingress unless a separate pooled-state metadata oracle is found.
payload.next_step: Continue by refreshing SOURCE_TARGETS or moving to another selector; the current state-ingress dynamic queue is drained except for contract-blocked SHOW TABLE STATUS.

title: SOURCE_TARGETS retired: IMPORT INTO precheck runs on a newly created session

analysis: The dynamic hit is checkTableEmpty in importer/precheck.go, which uses se.GetSQLExecutor().ExecuteInternal to run SELECT 1 FROM target USE INDEX() LIMIT 1
In product IMPORT INTO paths, CheckRequirements and CheckRequirementsBeforeInitDataFiles are not called with the user statement session
ImportIntoExec.Next explicitly creates newSCtx with CreateSession(e.userSctx), because precheck SQL would otherwise change SHOW PROCESSLIST statement text
importFromSelect repeats the same pattern and documents an additional reason: userSctx might be in stale read and precheck cannot use it for writes/metadata work
executor.CreateSession is wired by session.init to session.CreateSession(ctx.GetStore()), which creates a fresh session environment from the store
Tests may call CheckRequirements with tk.Session(), but that is a helper/unit-test convenience and not the product ownership chain
source_anchors: pkg/executor/importer/precheck.go:52-65 CheckRequirements/CheckRequirementsBeforeInitDataFiles call checkRequirements with the supplied session
pkg/executor/importer/precheck.go:115-122 checkTableEmpty executes internal SQL on se.GetSQLExecutor()
pkg/executor/import_into.go:119-132 creates newSCtx via CreateSession(e.userSctx) and runs precheck on newSCtx
pkg/executor/import_into.go:254-264 importFromSelect creates newSCtx and comments that userSctx might be in stale read
pkg/session/session.go:4017-4023 session.CreateSession creates a new session environment from the store
payload.why_not_execute: The candidate's first oracle would be pending user TxnReadTS consumption, but product code explicitly avoids using the stale-read user session for precheck. A RED would require changing the intended session provider rather than exercising a product-feasible user schedule.
payload.method_lesson: A positive source hit inside a helper should be retired when every product caller supplies a fresh session. Keep the helper as a negative sample: unit tests using tk.Session() do not establish product state-carrier ownership.
payload.next_step: Dynamic state-ingress queue is drained; run source-target refresh or pivot to a new selector/oracle-debt lane.
